notes.title: Playtime with Hoogie v4.0 update
notes.content:
- Fixed a feature where Hoogie will not move from his spawn point
if the 'Disable intros' option is not toggled.

- Added a option feature where you can auto continue the day without having to go the 
main menu.

Any other problems, just let me know :)
